qe: Read the passage and answer: 'Digital record-keeping in district offices has significantly reduced file processing delays. Earlier, physical registers required manual searching across dusty shelves, often taking days to locate an applicant's file. With indexed electronic archives and role-based access, clerks can retrieve verified records in seconds while preserving an audit trail.' — Question: According to the passage, what was the main drawback of physical registers?
qh: गद्यांश के अनुसार भौतिक रजिस्टरों की मुख्य कमी क्या थी?
oe: Manual searching across shelves caused days of delay
oh: वे बहुत बिजली खर्च करते थे
अलमारियों में मैन्युअल खोज करने से कई दिनों की देरी होती थी
e: Physical registers required manual searching across dusty shelves, taking days.

qe: Read the passage and answer: 'Digital record-keeping in district offices has significantly reduced file processing delays. Earlier, physical registers required manual searching across dusty shelves, often taking days to locate an applicant's file. With indexed electronic archives and role-based access, clerks can retrieve verified records in seconds while preserving an audit trail.' — Question: How do electronic archives improve office accountability?
qh: इलेक्ट्रॉनिक अभिलेखागार कार्यालय में जवाबदेही कैसे सुधारते हैं?
oe: By providing role-based access and preserving an audit trail
oh: रोल-आधारित पहुँच और ऑडिट ट्रेल सुरक्षित रखकर
e: The passage mentions indexed retrieval, role-based access, and preserving an audit trail.

qe: Read the passage and answer: 'Digital record-keeping in district offices has significantly reduced file processing delays. Earlier, physical registers required manual searching across dusty shelves, often taking days to locate an applicant's file. With indexed electronic archives and role-based access, clerks can retrieve verified records in seconds while preserving an audit trail.' — Question: Which word in the passage is closest in meaning to 'find and bring back'?
qh: गद्यांश में 'खोजकर वापस लाना' (find and bring back) के सबसे निकट अर्थ वाला शब्द कौन-सा है?
e: 'Retrieve' means to recover or fetch stored records.

qe: Cloze: 'A good clerk must stay (A) _____ to deadlines and handle public queries (B) _____.' Choose the best pair:
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'A good clerk must stay (A) _____ to deadlines and handle public queries (B) _____.'
e: Professional public administration requires commitment to deadlines and polite communication.

qe: Choose the correct Question Tag: 'She rarely misses her morning typing practice, ______?'
qh: सही Question Tag चुनें: 'She rarely misses her morning typing practice, ______?'
e: 'Rarely' is a negative adverb, so the tag is positive Simple Present: 'does she?'.

qe: Change to Passive Voice: 'The clerk typed all the letters yesterday.'
qh: Passive Voice में बदलें: 'The clerk typed all the letters yesterday.'
oe: All the letters have been typed yesterday.
All the letters were typed by the clerk yesterday.
All the letters are typed by the clerk yesterday.
All the letters were typing by the clerk.
oh: All the letters have been typed yesterday.
All the letters were typed by the clerk yesterday.
All the letters are typed by the clerk yesterday.
All the letters were typing by the clerk.
e: Simple Past Active ('typed') → Simple Past Passive ('were typed' for plural 'letters').

qe: Change to Active Voice: 'The file has been approved by the Director.'
qh: Active Voice में बदलें: 'The file has been approved by the Director.'
oe: The Director is approving the file.
The Director will approve the file.
The Director has approved the file.
oh: The Director is approving the file.
The Director will approve the file.
The Director has approved the file.
e: Present Perfect Passive ('has been approved') → Present Perfect Active ('has approved').

qe: Convert to Indirect Speech: He said to me, "Please help me fill out this form."
qh: Indirect Speech में बदलें: He said to me, "Please help me fill out this form."
oe: He asked why I helped him.
He ordered me help him fill this form.
He requested me to help him fill out that form.
He said please help me that form.
oh: He asked why I helped him.
He ordered me help him fill this form.
He requested me to help him fill out that form.
He said please help me that form.
e: 'Please' converts to 'requested + object + to + V₁', and 'this' changes to 'that'.

qe: Fill in the blank with the right preposition: 'The candidate is eligible ______ the post of Lower Division Clerk.'
qh: सही Preposition भरें: 'The candidate is eligible ______ the post of Lower Division Clerk.'
e: Standard usage: 'eligible for a post'.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'The jury ______ divided in their opinions on the case.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The jury ______ divided in their opinions on the case.'
e: When a collective noun ('jury') acts as divided individuals ('their opinions'), it takes a plural verb ('were').

qe: Fill in the blank with correct conditional: 'If you work hard, you ______ qualify the exam.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'If you work hard, you ______ qualify the exam.'
e: First conditional (If + Simple Present → Simple Future 'will + V₁').

qe: Fill in the blank with correct modal: '______ you please pass me the attendance register?' (Polite request)
qh: विनम्र अनुरोध के लिए सही Modal चुनें: '______ you please pass me the attendance register?'
e: 'Could you please...' is standard for polite requests.

qe: Choose the SYNONYM of 'AMEND':
qh: 'AMEND' (संशोधन/सुधार करना) का समानार्थी चुनें:
e: Amend means to make minor changes or improvements to text/law.

qe: Choose the ANTONYM of 'OBSOLETE' (outdated):
qh: 'OBSOLETE' (अप्रचलित/पुराना) का विलोम चुनें:
e: Obsolete = no longer used; Modern / Current = up to date.

qe: Choose the SYNONYM of 'METICULOUS':
qh: 'METICULOUS' (अति सूक्ष्म/सावधान) का समानार्थी चुनें:
e: Meticulous means showing extreme attention to detail.

qe: Choose the ANTONYM of 'HARMONY':
qh: 'HARMONY' (सामंजस्य/सद्भाव) का विलोम चुनें:
e: Harmony = agreement/peace; Discord = disagreement/strife.

qe: One-word substitution for: 'A person who is unable to pay his debts'
qh: वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द: 'A person who is unable to pay his debts'
e: Insolvent / Bankrupt cannot pay owed debts.

qe: One-word substitution for: 'A handwriting that cannot be read'
qh: वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द: 'A handwriting that cannot be read'
e: Illegible = unreadable handwriting; Incorrigible = incapable of being corrected; Indelible = cannot be erased.

qe: Choose the word with the CORRECT spelling for 'a formal written order/receipt':
qh: 'प्राप्ति / रसीद / स्वीकृति' अर्थ वाले शब्द की सही वर्तनी चुनें:
e: Rule 'i before e except after c': R-E-C-E-I-P-T.

qe: Choose the word with the CORRECT spelling for 'something strictly needed':
qh: 'आवश्यक' अर्थ वाले शब्द की सही वर्तनी चुनें:
e: One 'c', double 's': N-E-C-E-S-S-A-R-Y.

qe: What is the meaning of the idiom 'In black and white'?
qh: 'In black and white' मुहावरे का अर्थ क्या है?
oe: In written or printed official form
e: 'Put it in black and white' means putting an agreement or instruction in writing.

qe: What is the meaning of the idiom 'At the eleventh hour'?
qh: 'At the eleventh hour' मुहावरे का सही अर्थ क्या है?
oe: At the very last possible moment before a deadline
oh: अंतिम समय / बिल्कुल आखिरी क्षण में
e: 'At the eleventh hour' means just before it is too late.

qe: Arrange to form a meaningful sentence: 1. submitted  2. the report  3. on time  4. the officer  5. carefully
qh: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने हेतु सही क्रम चुनें: 1. submitted  2. the report  3. on time  4. the officer  5. carefully
e: 4-5-1-2-3 forms: 'The officer carefully submitted the report on time.'

qe: Identify the sentence in Present Perfect tense:
qh: Present Perfect Tense वाला वाक्य चुनें:
e: has/have + V₃ ('has written') is Present Perfect tense.

qe: Spot the error: 'Scarcely had he reached (A) / the office than (B) / the meeting started. (C) / No error (D)'
qh: त्रुटि वाला भाग पहचानें: 'Scarcely had he reached (A) / the office than (B) / the meeting started. (C) / No error (D)'
e: 'Hardly / Scarcely ... when' is the correct correlative pair ('No sooner ... than').

qe: Improve the underlined/quoted part: 'She is senior "than" me in the office.'
qh: रेखांकित/उद्धृत भाग सुधारें: 'She is senior "than" me in the office.'
e: Latin comparatives (senior, junior, superior, inferior, prior) always take 'to', never 'than'.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'One should always keep ______ word.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'One should always keep ______ word.'
e: When the indefinite pronoun 'One' is the subject, its possessive pronoun is 'one's'.

qe: Choose the correct collocation with 'attention':
qh: 'attention' के साथ सही अंग्रेजी कोलोकेशन चुनें:
e: 'Pay attention' is the standard idiomatic collocation.

qe: Fill in the blank with correct article: 'Patna is situated on the banks of ______ Ganga.'
qh: सही Article से रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Patna is situated on the banks of ______ Ganga.'
e: Definite article 'the' precedes names of rivers ('the Ganga').

qe: Choose the SYNONYM of 'CANDID':
qh: 'CANDID' (स्पष्टवादी/निष्कपट) का समानार्थी चुनें:
e: Candid means truthful, frank, and straightforward.
